note: Both sets capture the four Table 6-2 properties plus the prose statement of overall tower height, and both keep the damping condition (isolated tower, without rotor-nacelle assembly mass). Set B attaches a spurious condition 'overall' to the height-above-ground claim (that word belongs to 'overall tower height', not to the table's height-above-ground row), and its CM attribute is vaguer than A's full label. Set A binds every value cleanly with the full row labels, so it is slightly more faithful, though both repeat 87.6 m under two names and both cite the table row as the quote for the 'overall height' claim.
remarks: Both sets state 87.6 m twice (height above ground and overall tower height); the prose treats 'overall tower height' as the source of the height-above-ground result, so these are arguably one fact under two names. The quote used for the 'overall height' claim is the table row 'Height above Ground', which does not itself say 'overall height' — the supporting wording is in the prose ('overall tower height of 87.6 m'). The DOWEC/Ref. [14] provenance of the 1% damping value is on the page but omitted by both (reference material, neutral).
